steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: A sea of people floods the grounds before the House of Tales, thronging its entrance. The crowd encircles the small building where Yugu holds court, the ground already strewn with flowers and fruits—a scene of jubilant celebration.

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: Outside the gate, a white banner bears bold characters proudly proclaiming—Hazy Fete in a Daze: Volume II.

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: It is none other than the story she has prepared just for you.

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: After much effort to squeeze through the crowd, the outlander arrives just as the taleteller begins her story.
[Yugu's portrait]

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: They say, a hundred miles south of the town, a female ghost wandered. Her beauty was beyond compare, yet destruction followed in her wake. With her enchanting form, she lured victims into the mountains, draining their life before casting them aside like refuse.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Yet neither monks nor priests could subdue her—some lacked the spiritual might to match her power, while others fell victim to her bewitching beauty. For over a decade, none could bring her to heel.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Yet, who could have foreseen such a twist? This fearsome ghost, with all her countless sins, one day relinquished her powers, professing an absurd notion of self-reformation—declaring, "I vow to wed none but him."
steps.female_content: Yet, who could have foreseen such a twist? This fearsome ghost, with all her countless sins, one day relinquished her powers, professing an absurd notion of self-reformation—declaring, "I vow to wed none but her."

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: And just who was this mysterious figure who managed to tame such a sinister ghost?

steps.speaker: Spirit Audience
steps.content: —!!

You look around at the audience cheering for her performance—not a single one appears remotely human. Every last one of them is some manner of fiend or spirit, wild-eyed and grotesque in appearance. You can't help but find the situation somewhat amusing.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Creating a fake audience to applaud your own made-up story? Hah, what a narcissistic author we have here.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: I wonder if a "taleteller" like yourself can handle having your tales criticized.

You take the teacup from a spirit server and slam it onto the table with a thunderous crash that echoes through the hall. In an instant, every spirit spectator falls dead silent, all eyes fixed upon you.
Even the taleteller on stage pauses her performance, slowly raising her head until her gaze locks with yours.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: My... do you find my story dissatisfying again, dear guest?
Her words inciting, she's clearly waiting for you to make your move. You step forward to confront her.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: The story's quality isn't the issue here. I came in because of the sign outside, but it looks like you're pulling a bit of a bait-and-switch here.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Telling all this ghost story of supernatural nonsense, are you?

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Change the story! Tell me what this Fete really is—how you're using it to lure people in and drain their life!

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Tell me what these "guests" of yours really are, and what evil scheme you, the taleteller, are plotting here!
The taleteller puts on an act of pure innocence.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: My dear guest, if the festivities trouble you, direct your inquiries to the rightful host—the mistress of the Wisteria Pavilion, that spirit who breathes life into the blossoms across the streets. Why burden a humble taleteller like myself?

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: I am not even part of this fete—merely a wanderer passing through, an outsider present just to hear a story.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: "An outsider?" I'd say this entire fete materialized straight from your "story."
You stride purposefully toward the performance stage at the center. The audience shoots disapproving glances your way, but you pay them no mind.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Let's cut to the chase—this fete, these spectators, even the ancient tree out there, the flower spirit, every single plant and leaf—they're all just illusions you've conjured up.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content:
In this entire street, you're the only real human here—along with all those 
DisCitizens you've trapped in your scheme.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: All this effort to set up the Wisteria Pavilion, staging these absurd scenes to deceive people... and then forcing them to stay against their will.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: I heard Eastians pride themselves on their sense of propriety. Aren't you embarrassed to stoop this low?
The taleteller gives you a smile, eyes narrowing.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Oh? Are you going to flip the table in a rage and leave in the middle of the show, my dear guest?

steps.speaker: Option
options: Now that would be too dull of a plot.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: End this absurd soul-draining fete and release your hostages. Now.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Heh... If you follow my script perfectly, step by step, the fete shall end in due time. Why such impatience?

steps.speaker: Option
options: I'm not impatient. I'm just tired of your story.

steps.content: [Release the shackles]
Though your strength is nearly spent, you summon every last ounce of power to unleash the shackles. A crimson light erupts, shattering the stage rails.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Worthless stories. Even all these cheap tricks can't keep your audience. Stop forcing your performance on everyone—you're wasting our time.
In an instant, the guests dissolve like mist, leaving the taleteller alone on the stage.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Well, well... I almost forgot what a fascinating being you are. Such remarkable power—how wonderful it would be to weave you into my collection of tales... Yet, before we proceed, let us establish some ground rules.
Her gentle smile never wavers as she raises her hand with delicate grace, and then...
(Multiple portraits appear)
The fiends and spirits from her bizarre tales materialize one by one, their intimidating howls filling the air as they lunge at you!

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: This marks your second interruption of my story. A toll must be paid for such disturbances... Don't you agree, Chief?
